results.title: Russia is selling gas to China at half price — because it has to.
results.description:
Russia is selling gas to China at half price — because it has to.

Duma documents show Beijing pays about $248 per 1,000 cubic metres for Gazprom pipeline gas in 2026, vs $562 for other foreign buyers. A 56% discount.

That is what losing your best customer looks like.

results.title: China's factories shrank again in October, as Russian projections show Beijing paying 56% less than others for its gas.
results.description:
China's factories shrank again in October, as Russian projections show Beijing paying 56% less than others for its gas.

The renewed contraction complicates China's growth target. Russia's projections put China's 2026 pipeline gas price at about $248 per thousand cubic meters, against $562 for Gazprom's other non-former-Soviet buyers.

results.title: In October, shipments of Russian oil from Baltic and Arctic seas ports to China via Northern Sea Route continued Launch of Vostok‑Oil became
results.description:
In October,  shipments of Russian oil from Baltic and Arctic seas ports to China via Northern Sea Route continued

Launch of Vostok‑Oil became a key factor in the growth of shipments along the eastern route of Northern Sea Route this year.

Using the Arctic route for supplies from the Baltic reduces the voyage time to China by half (from 51 days from Ust‑Luga to Qingdao around the Cape of Good Hope to 27 days via the Northern Sea Route). 

Even seasonal use of NSR helps to improve economy of Russian crude oil exports. At the same time, navigation through the Bering Strait will be closed in November and flows will be reset.

results.title: You give China waaay too much credit.
